# Module M-08: Read stock on hand beside each line

## Lesson

You do this when you confirm an order. When it works, each line shows the stock on hand for its code, as of the last evening update. [SC-08]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open a confirmed order in the confirmation view. [SC-08 step 1]
2. Compare each line's stock on hand with the stock sheet of the same day. [SC-08 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

Stock that looks wrong comes from the stock sheet; check it there first. [CO-01]
